46:   return [
47:     {
48:       title: "Sharpen an opportunity",
49:       label: "Turn a hunch into something defensible",
50:       prompt: OPPORTUNITY_PROMPT,
51:     },
52:     state.outcomeCount > 0
53:       ? {
54:           title: "Pressure-test a bet",
55:           label: "Find what would have to be true",

80:     streaming,
81:     canvas,
82:     sendMessage,
83:     regenerateFrom,
84:     editFrom,
85:     switchBranch,
86:     respondToApproval,
87:     stopStreaming,

91:   const jobCount = canvas?.jobs.length ?? 0;
92:   const outcomeCount = canvas?.outcomes.length ?? 0;
93:   const suggestions = useMemo(
94:     () => suggestionsFor({ jobCount, outcomeCount }),

96:   );

99:     isRunning: streaming,
100:     messages,
101:     convertMessage: toThreadMessageLike,
102:     suggestions,
103:     adapters: { attachments },
104:     onNew: async (message) => {
